activity_summary: On the way home you stopped at the end of the burned row. The cousin's frame was four bays of green oak, almost yellow, lying on the ground. It was not raised. No one was in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked once, and did not stay.

entities.name: the cousin's frame
entities.context: Mentioned in The four bays of green oak at the end plot

facets.activity: Looked at the oak lying at the end of the burned row
